methods.rgb: Successive differences of spatial mean RGB in up to 8x8 cells per camera.
methods.proprio: 12 consecutive 25-control means of all nine measured state channels.
methods.commands: 12 consecutive 25-control means of all seven issued command channels.
methods.fit: Per goal, pool both variants on poses 12-15. Scale state and command channels by their fit standard deviation. Compute separate hit and miss centroids.
methods.score: Euclidean distance to miss divided by summed distances to miss and hit. After two zeros choose the goal with the lower score. This score is uncalibrated.
methods.ties: Equal scores within 1e-12 or an unavailable class in either reader give equal destination probabilities. A missing completion score is null.
methods.swap: Replace both practice trajectories with their opposite-variant executions at the same starts. Preserve hidden goal, factual rewards and query branches.

counting: Each strict triple contributes two opposite hidden goals. Native projections weight the two recorded BASE branches by choice probability. Before filtering, interpret the two-zero rule only where two_zeros is true. All-order sensitivity includes the cyclic triples and reuses the same 16 physical tapes per split. Counts are descriptive.
